title: 意大利开局：五步准备一次 d4
title_en: The Italian Game: Five Moves to Prepare d4
summary: 不背一串着法，而是连续完成出象、稳中心、准备兵突破和发展后翼马。
summary_en: Don't memorize a line of moves. Instead, develop the bishop, stabilize the center, prepare a pawn break, and bring out the queenside knight.
introduction: 很多人知道意大利开局要把象放到 c4，却不知道下一步做什么。真正的计划不是把棋子摆到熟悉位置，而是为中心的 d4 突破逐项准备。
你将连续做五次选择。每一步都很安静，但它们共同回答一个问题：怎样让 d4 推进时不丢兵，还能顺便完成发展。
introduction_en: Many people know the Italian Game puts a bishop on c4, but not what to do next. The real plan is not putting pieces on familiar squares; it is preparing the d4 break in the center one step at a time.
You will make five choices in a row. Each move is quiet, but together they answer one question: how to push d4 without dropping a pawn while developing at the same time.

culture.title: 最古老的开放性开局之一
culture.content: 意大利开局在十六世纪棋谱中就已出现。它长期流行，不是因为只有一条强制变化，而是因为它把中心、发展和王的安全放进了一个容易理解的计划。

culture_en.title: One of the oldest open games
culture_en.content: The Italian Game already appears in sixteenth-century manuals. It stays popular not because it has a single forcing line, but because it folds the center, development and king safety into one easy-to-understand plan.

challenge.title: 五步搭好中心突破的脚手架
challenge.instruction: 先发展，再支撑，最后推进 d4。对手会正常发展，你要保持计划连贯。
challenge.goal: 白方走五步，完成意大利式发展并推进 d4。

steps.note: 第一步正确：Bc4 把象放到活跃对角线，同时关注 f7。
第二步正确：d3 先稳住 e4，为 c3 与 d4 留出清晰次序。
第三步正确：c3 控制 d4，并准备让 d 兵前进后仍有兵链支持。
第四步正确：Nbd2 完成后翼马发展，同时不给 d 兵造成阻挡。
第五步正确：d4 终于提出中心问题。前四步让这次推进不再是孤立冲动，而是完整计划的兑现。

challenge.success: 五步计划完成。你没有机械背谱，而是依次完成活跃出象、稳住 e4、用 c3 支撑、发展后翼马，最后用 d4 争夺中心。
challenge.defaultAnswer: 这套次序的逻辑是让每一步都服务于 d4：Bc4 发展，d3 稳 e4，c3 支撑 d4，Nbd2 完成发展，最后 d4 才有足够基础。

errors.d2d4: 立即 d4 不是不可下，但在本课局面中白方还没完成 c3 支撑与子力发展，交换后容易过早简化。
errors.b1c3: Nc3 是自然棋，却会挡住 c 兵，改变 c3-d4 的意大利式计划。本题要体验 Nbd2 的分工。

challenge.genericError: 这步可能符合一般开局原则，但请检查它是否直接服务于本课的 d4 中心计划。

quick.为什么先d3: d3 先保护 e4，确保白方准备 c3 和 d4 时中心兵不会松动。
quick.为什么马走d2: Nbd2 既发展马，又保留 c 兵走到 c3 的通道。Nc3 并不坏，但对应另一套中心结构。
quick.为什么第五步才d4: 前四步是在降低 d4 的成本：更多子力参与、中心有支撑、交换后也能自然回吃。

suggestions.label: 为什么第五步才走 d4？

challenge_en.title: Five moves to build the scaffold for a center break
challenge_en.instruction: Develop first, then support, then push d4. The opponent develops normally; keep your plan coherent.
challenge_en.goal: White moves five times, completing Italian-style development and advancing d4.

steps.note: First move correct: Bc4 puts the bishop on an active diagonal, eyeing f7.
Second move correct: d3 first stabilizes e4, leaving a clear order for c3 and d4.
Third move correct: c3 controls d4 and prepares a pawn chain to support the d-pawn's advance.
Fourth move correct: Nbd2 completes the queenside knight's development without blocking the d-pawn.
Fifth move correct: d4 finally poses the central question. The first four moves turn this push from a lone impulse into the payoff of a complete plan.

challenge_en.success: Five-move plan complete. You did not memorize mechanically; you developed an active bishop, stabilized e4, supported with c3, developed the queenside knight, and finally contested the center with d4.
challenge_en.defaultAnswer: The logic of this order is that every move serves d4: Bc4 develops, d3 stabilizes e4, c3 supports d4, Nbd2 completes development, and only then does d4 have a solid foundation.

errors.d2d4: Immediate d4 is not unplayable, but in this position White has not yet completed the c3 support and development, so the exchange tends to simplify too early.
errors.b1c3: Nc3 is a natural move, but it blocks the c-pawn and changes the Italian c3-d4 plan. This lesson explores the Nbd2 division of labor.

challenge_en.genericError: This move may follow general opening principles, but check whether it directly serves this lesson's d4 center plan.

quick.为什么先d3: d3 first protects e4, ensuring the center pawn does not loosen while White prepares c3 and d4.
quick.为什么马走d2: Nbd2 develops the knight while keeping the c-pawn's path to c3 open. Nc3 is fine too, but it belongs to a different center structure.
quick.为什么第五步才d4: The first four moves lower the cost of d4: more pieces take part, the center is supported, and recaptures come naturally after exchanges.

suggestions.label: Why not develop the knight to c3?
Why push d4 only on move five?

review.title: 开局着法要组成计划
steps: Bc4 发展并对准 f7，建立意大利开局的基本方向。
d3 与 c3 分别稳住 e4、支持 d4。
Nbd2 完成发展，同时保留 c 兵路线。
d4 是前面四步的兑现，而不是突然想到的兵推进。
review.principle: 学习开局时不要只记顺序，要能说出每一步为最终中心突破增加了什么条件。

review_en.title: Opening moves must form a plan
steps: Bc4 develops and aims at f7, setting the Italian direction.
d3 and c3 respectively stabilize e4 and support d4.
Nbd2 completes development while keeping the c-pawn's route open.
d4 is the payoff of the previous four moves, not a sudden pawn push.
review_en.principle: When learning an opening, don't just memorize the order — be able to say what each move adds to the final center break.
